reviews.text: Mina is the best!! These are my favorite eyelashes by far, I love them so much. She did such a great job working with my stubborn eyelashes.
Great location, easy access and parking and my lashes always look flawless. Mina is my lash professional and she is timely and always does a natural lash that I like. I get the hybrid cat eye!
I’ve been coming to see Mina for almost a year and a half and she always does a beautiful job. My lashes last about a month with good care. I could always fall asleep with how gently she works!
